question: What is the maximum lump sum group life cover a member can have?

result.question: What is the maximum lump sum group life cover a member can have?
result.answer: The maximum lump sum group life cover per member is R25 000 000. This cap applies regardless of the member's salary or the cover multiple chosen. Cover itself is worked out from a multiple of annual pensionable salary: the employer selects a multiple between 1x and 5x, in whole multiples, and the same multiple applies to all members in a category — but the lump sum can never go above the R25 000 000 maximum.

question: A member is leaving their employer. How long do they have to take up the continuation option, and up to what amount of cover?

result.question: A member is leaving their employer. How long do they have to take up the continuation option, and up to what amount of cover?
result.answer: A member who leaves the employer's service before normal retirement age may apply to continue their life cover on an individual Kestrel policy without providing medical evidence. The application must be received within 60 days of leaving service, and the cover under the continuation option is limited to the lower of the member's group cover and R5 000 000.
result.reason: The current 2026 Group Life Product Guide section 4 states both the 60-day deadline and the lower-of cover limit for the continuation option.

The application must be received within 60 days of leaving service. Cover under the continuation option is limited to the lower of the member's group cover and R5 000 000.
citations.supports: The 60-day application window, the lower-of limit of R5 000 000 and group cover, and the conditions (before normal retirement age, no medical evidence needed).

caveats: The amount is a limit, not a fixed sum: it is the lower of the member's group cover and R5 000 000, so the actual amount depends on the member's group cover.
The option applies only to members leaving before normal retirement age, and only if the application is received within 60 days of leaving service.

result.question: What is the group life free cover limit for a scheme with 320 members?
result.answer:
A scheme with 320 members falls in Band 4 (schemes with 250 to 499 members), so the group life free cover limit is R5 000 000.

Members are covered without medical evidence up to that free cover limit, and any cover above it is subject to underwriting.

result.question: A scheme has 1 200 members. What is the disability income free cover limit?
result.answer: For a scheme with 1 200 members, the disability income free cover limit is R 120 000 per month. This is Band 6, which covers schemes with 1 000 members and above. The limit is set at scheme inception and reviewed at each annual review date, based on the number of members at that date, and it applies only to members who are actively at work when cover starts. Cover above the limit requires medical evidence and is subject to underwriting acceptance.

question: Under disability Option C, what monthly benefit would a member earning R50 000 a month receive?

result.question: Under disability Option C, what monthly benefit would a member earning R50 000 a month receive?
result.answer:
Under Option C, a member earning R50 000 a month would receive R42 500 a month.

How it is worked out: Option C pays 100% of the first R20 000 of monthly salary, plus 75% of the balance. So R20 000 is paid in full, and 75% of the remaining R30 000 is R22 500, giving R42 500 a month. That is below Option C's maximum monthly benefit of R300 000, so no cap applies. "Salary" means the member's monthly pensionable salary at the date disability started, and Option C has a 3-month waiting period and 5% fixed annual escalation.

This illustrates the general rule only — the claims team decides individual claims.

question: What documents are needed to submit a disability claim?

result.question: What documents are needed to submit a disability claim?
result.answer:
For a disability claim the documents needed are:
- A completed Kestrel disability claim form (employer section and member section)
- A medical report from the treating doctor
- The member's last 3 payslips
- A certified copy of the member's ID document

The claim should be submitted as soon as possible and no later than 3 months after the end of the waiting period. It can be submitted by the employer or broker through the Kestrel Broker Portal, or by email to claims@kestrel-assurance.example. Disability claims may take longer than the 10 working days Kestrel aims for on group life claims, because medical information may need to be obtained.

question: Within what period must a member's death be notified to Kestrel?

result.question: Within what period must a member's death be notified to Kestrel?
result.answer:
For group life cover, the death of a member must be notified to Kestrel within 6 months of the date of death. Claims notified later may be declined.

So on a call you can say: "You need to tell us about the death within six months of the date of death — if it comes in later the claim may be declined."

The Claims FAQ then lists what to send in: a completed Kestrel death claim form, a certified copy of the death certificate, a certified copy of the deceased member's ID document, and a certified copy of each beneficiary's ID document plus a bank confirmation letter. Once all required documents are in, Kestrel aims to decide group life claims within 10 working days (disability claims may take longer, and funeral claims are paid within 48 hours of receiving complete documents).

question: What is the premium rate per R1 000 of life cover for a scheme with 150 members?

result.question: What is the premium rate per R1 000 of life cover for a scheme with 150 members?
result.answer:
The documents do not state a premium rate per R1 000 of life cover. Group life premiums are quoted as a percentage of the total annual salary bill of covered members, not as a rate per R1 000 of cover.

For context only, 150 members falls in Band 3 (100 to 249 members), and that band sets the group life free cover limit at R3 500 000. That is a free cover limit, not a premium rate.

For the actual rate for a 150-member scheme, the agent should ask underwriting or the broker for a quote.

result.question: How long does Kestrel take to make a decision on a group life claim?
result.answer: Kestrel aims to make a decision on group life claims within 10 working days of receiving all required documents. This is a target, not a guarantee, and the clock only starts once all the required documents are in. Disability claims may take longer because medical information may need to be obtained.

heading_path: How long does it take to assess a claim?
hit.text: Kestrel aims to make a decision on group life claims within 10 working days of receiving all required documents. Disability claims may take longer because medical information may need to be obtained. Funeral claims are paid within 48 hours of receiving complete documents.

hit.title: Claims Frequently Asked Questions (updated March 2026)
hit.locator: section "What if I am unhappy with a claim decision?"
heading_path: What if I am unhappy with a claim decision?
hit.text: You can ask for the decision to be reviewed by writing to complaints@kestrel-assurance.example within 90 days of the decision. If you are still not satisfied, you may refer the matter to the long-term insurance ombud.

hit.title: Group Disability Income Benefit Product Guide (Version 2026.1)
heading_path: Group Disability Income Benefit: Product Guide
hit.text: Claims should be submitted as soon as possible and no later than 3 months after the end of the waiting period. See the Kestrel Claims FAQ for the documents required.

heading_path: Can I check the status of a claim?
hit.text: Yes. Employers and brokers can track claims on the Broker Portal. Members can call the Kestrel Client Centre on 0800 000 000 (fictitious number), Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 17:00.

hit.title: Claims Frequently Asked Questions (updated March 2026)

heading_path: How do I submit a claim?
hit.text: Claims can be submitted by the employer or broker through the Kestrel Broker Portal, or by email to claims@kestrel-assurance.example.

hit.text: Funeral claims are paid within 48 hours of Kestrel receiving all the required documents.

hit.title: Group Life Assurance Product Guide (Version 2026.1)
